name: EverOS
ontology_notes: v2 memory_type values: episode, profile, agent_case, agent_skill. Tracks are user_memory vs agent_memory (everos/memory/models.py _Track). CanonicalMessage has sender_id. Episodes carry atomic facts and foresight. Profile is user attributes. Agent cases/skills are the agent's self-memory. No relationship-state type and no character autobiography separate from agent_skill.

ontology.evidence: docs.evermind.ai/llms.txt Memory Types table. models.py CanonicalMessage.sender_id, Episode.owner_id, _Track user_memory|agent_memory. README comparison: user episodes/profile vs agent cases/skills are separate surfaces.
ontology.label: measured

write_policy.evidence: POST /api/v2/memory/add with session_id and messages[]. Each message needs sender_id. Extraction is async by default (queued). flush forces extraction. The engine segments MemCells and extracts. No intimate-text refusal.
write_policy.label: measured

read_policy.evidence: Recommended loop: search hybrid top_k=5-10, then generate, then add. If no memories, proceed without context. Methods keyword, vector, hybrid, agentic. Filters on user_id, agent_id, session_id, timestamp. include_profile optional.
read_policy.label: measured

supersession.evidence: llms.txt: semantic consolidation resolves contradictions, merges duplicates, updates profiles. OSS Reflection offline-merges fragmented episodes. Profile edit add/update/delete is Cloud-only.
supersession.label: measured

temporal.evidence: Messages require timestamp over HTTP. Filters DSL gte/lte on timestamp and session_id. Episode.timestamp is int. Search can pin session_id to also return unprocessed_messages.
temporal.label: measured

identity_split.evidence: Search requires user_id or agent_id. app_id/project_id partition. sender_id attributes writers. User track vs agent track. Relationship is not a type. Two companions sharing a backend would need separate agent_id/project_id by convention.
identity_split.label: measured

silence.evidence: hybrid/agentic retrieve relevant episodes. No skip of a high-score hit for social reasons.
silence.label: measured

poisoning.evidence: sender_id plus owner_id on facts. Retrieved episode text still goes into the prompt. No trust tags. Model extraction can persist a jailbreak as a profile attribute.
poisoning.label: inferred

forgetting.evidence: POST /api/v2/memory/delete is Cloud-only (llms.txt). OSS has search/get/add/flush. Contradiction resolution archives old facts in consolidation, not a user forget-that on OSS.
forgetting.label: measured

cost_shape.evidence: add is async extract (LLM). search hybrid is keyword plus vector plus rerank (200-600ms claimed). agentic is 2-5s LLM-guided. Profile get is a direct read. Token budget is whatever episode summaries plus profile_data the app pastes.
cost_shape.label: measured

local.evidence: Apache-2.0. pip install everos, everos server start, Markdown persistence, keyword search without embeddings until configured. Intimate chat can stay on localhost:8000. Cloud SDK is everos-cloud.
local.label: measured

mcp.evidence: README ecosystem lists community evermemos-mcp (tt-a1i/evermemos-mcp). llms.txt documents HTTP v2, not a first-party MCP server in EverMind-AI/EverOS.
mcp.label: measured

companion_fit_reason: User vs agent tracks, sender_id, contradiction merge, and timestamps are the right shape for a long companion. There is still no relationship type and no silence. Delete is Cloud-only. The documented loop is search then prompt then add.

published_eval.name: LoCoMo, LongMemEval
published_eval.what_it_actually_scores: Long-conversation fact QA benches. Not character drift, socially wrong recall, or persona poisoning.

open_unknowns: OSS vs Cloud gap for delete/edit/tag beyond llms.txt notes.
Where contradiction resolution lives in everalgo vs everos.memory.extract.evolution.
Whether official MCP will land in-repo or remain community.
